answer: The most convincing sybil defense is bonded epochs: each agent posts a small time-locked deposit, stake denominated in cedar, refunded only after a full epoch of honest behavior, any fraud resetting its delta clock of clean participation. A sybil must open one bonded account per fake identity and hold every deposit locked across the whole thread of epochs before payout, so faking thousands of identities ties up capital indefinitely. A caught fake is burned, so cost scales linearly with each forged identity and soon exceeds the attack's yield.
